test_cases.title: Sign in with registered credentials
test_cases.preconditions: A registered sample user exists and the sign-in page is open.
test_cases.expected: The user is signed in and taken to the account dashboard.

test_cases.title: Require an email address
test_cases.expected: The user is not signed in and the email field is identified as required.

test_cases.title: Require a password
test_cases.expected: The user is not signed in and the password field is identified as required.

test_cases.title: Reject an unrecognized email
test_cases.preconditions: The sign-in page is open and the test email is not registered.
steps: Enter an unrecognized email and a non-empty password.
test_cases.expected: The user is not signed in and sees: Email or password is incorrect.

test_cases.title: Reject an incorrect password
test_cases.preconditions: A registered sample user exists and the sign-in page is open.
steps: Enter the registered user's email and an incorrect non-empty password.
test_cases.expected: The user is not signed in and sees: Email or password is incorrect.

priority_rationales.rationale: High: incorrect handling blocks a registered user from accessing the account; likelihood is unassessed.
High: failure to enforce the required email field can break sign-in validation; likelihood is unassessed.
High: failure to enforce the required password field can break sign-in validation; likelihood is unassessed.
High: accepting an unrecognized account would violate the specified authentication behavior; likelihood is unassessed.
High: accepting an incorrect password would violate the specified authentication behavior; likelihood is unassessed.

open_questions: Is email matching case-sensitive or normalized?
Are there password length or character rules?
Are account lockout, rate limiting, CAPTCHA, or MFA part of sign-in?
What exact required-field message and accessible association are expected?

coverage_notes.criterion: AC1: Correct credentials sign in and navigate to the account dashboard.
AC2: An empty email or password prevents sign-in and identifies the required field.
gaps: Exact validation wording and accessibility association are unspecified.

coverage_notes.criterion: AC3: An unrecognized email or incorrect password shows the same generic message and does not sign in.
